answer.explanation: From 15:41 to 15:51 UTC the Thumbnailer logged about 389 AccessDenied errors on s3:PutObject to lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi/thumbnailer/*. The role's live inline policy app-policy only grants s3:GetObject on the input bucket; the WriteOutput statement (s3:PutObject on the output bucket) that the IaC template defines is missing. The other three functions logged no errors in the window. The live configuration (environment variables, memory, timeout, concurrency) matches the IaC template, and the recent OUTPUT_BUCKET commits (44a967f, c5cd710) were reverted, so they are not the cause. The IaC template itself still declares the correct grant, so the drift is in the deployed role policy.
